## Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem? Describe it clearly.
e.g. *"I'm always frustrated when..."*

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives Considered
Any alternative solutions or features you've thought about.

## User Impact
Who benefits from this feature and how?
- **Who:** e.g. developers, end users, admins
- **Benefit:** e.g. saves time, reduces errors, improves accessibility

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Behaviour 1
- [ ] Behaviour 2
- [ ] Behaviour 3

## Additional Context
Add any mockups, screenshots, or links that help explain the request.
